verses.1: I have said these things to you so that you will not be deceived.
verses.2: They will bring you together again. But now comes the time when each of those who destroys you will offer you worship to the god.
verses.3: And they will do all these things because they did not know the father, nor me either.
verses.4: But I said all these things to you, so that when the time comes for them to be remembered, you will remember that I told you. But I never said all these things from the beginning; I never meant to stay with you.
verses.5: But now, I urge upon those who sent me that none of you will be willing to help me. Who will do so?
verses.6: But what I have said to you has filled your hearts with sorrow.
verses.7: But I tell you the truth: it’s better for me to leave. If I don’t leave, then the messenger won’t come to you either. But if I do leave, I’ll send him to you instead.
verses.8: And when he came there, he examined the world regarding sin, justice, and judgment.
verses.9: Regarding sin, it is because they do not believe in me.
verses.10: As for justice, I demand that I be treated as a father’s child, and that I not be considered anything other than that.
verses.11: As for the judgment, it is said that the ruler of this world is to be judged.
verses.12: I still have many things to say to you, but you can’t stand it right now.
verses.13: And when that person comes, the spirit of truth will guide you in all things. He won’t speak from his own authority; instead, he will speak what he hears, and he will also proclaim to you what is to come.
verses.14: He will show me that it is from me that he sends these messages to you.
verses.15: Everything that my father has is also mine. That’s why I said that he receives it from me and reports it to you.
verses.16: I’m considered small again, and no longer taken seriously. Again, I’m seen as small and insignificant.
verses.17: So they said to each other among their disciples: “What does this mean? Should I be considered small, or not? And again, should I be seen as small?” And they also said, “Should I go to my father?”
verses.18: So they said, “What is this little thing that he says? We don’t know what he’s talking about.”
verses.19: Jesus knew that they wanted to love him. So he said to them, “Ask me about this together. Don’t think too much about it. And again, don’t judge me too harshly.”
verses.20: I truly say to you that you will mourn and grieve, but the world will be happy. You will suffer sorrow, but that sorrow will turn into joy for you.
verses.21: When a woman feels sorrow, it’s because it’s her time to die. But when she gives birth to a child, she no longer remembers her sorrow, because of the joy that comes from having a child who becomes a person for the world.
verses.22: And now, you all suffer sorrow. But once again, I see you; your hearts will be filled with joy. And no one can take away that joy from you.
verses.23: And on that day, you will not ask me for anything. Indeed, I tell you, if you ask my father, he will give you something in my name.
verses.24: Until noon, you did not say anything about my name. Please ask and be informed, so that your joy can be fulfilled.
verses.25: I have spoken to you in metaphors. But now it’s time for me to speak to you no longer in metaphors, but in plain language about our father.
verses.26: On that day, ask for my help in that name. I do not tell you that I desire to marry your father.
verses.27: For it is He, the Father, who loves you. You have loved me and believed that I came from God.
verses.28: We have come from our father, and we are now free in the world. Once again, I will return to the world, and I will go towards my father.
verses.29: The disciples say that he now speaks in a strange manner; he doesn’t say anything meaningful at all.
verses.30: Now we know that you know everything, and that it’s not necessary for anyone to love you. In this, we believe that you came from God.
verses.31: Jesus replied to them, “Do you believe?”
verses.32: It seems that the time has come for each of us to go our own way. But I’m not alone in this; my father is also with me.
verses.33: I have said these things to you so that you may have peace in me. You live in sorrow in this world, but rejoice, for I have overcome the world.
